_about: AudioMix.cs (lane laneRCHYGIENE, v100). The mix: one level per category. master rides on AudioListener.volume; every other category multiplies the volume of the sources that route through it (CueBus: cues[] below picks the category of each cue; GatewayRift: ambience; a looping source: AudioMix.Bind(source, category, baseVolume)). defaultLevel = the value before the player touches a slider and what 'Restore defaults' sets; min / max = the slider limits; menu=false hides the slider (a category with no sound in it yet: ui, music). cues[]: cue = an exact CueBus cue name, or a prefix ending in '*'; anything not listed plays in defaultCategory. pause: the pause menu fades the sound out over fadeOutS (and in over fadeInS) in unscaled time before AudioListener.pause; fade=false pauses at once. display: how the menu prints a slider (value x scale, format fmt, suffix). The player's levels are saved in settings.json (mix[]). No audio assets are added by this file.
